_comment: Reusable requirement fragments. A program requirement of the form {"$include": "name"} is replaced by the matching block below when programs are loaded. Keeps common Purdue sequences (calculus, university core) in one place.

university_core_science.name: University Core Curriculum & College of Science Core
university_core_science.note: Written/oral communication, Great Issues, STS, lab science, language & culture, and general-education selectives. Verify the exact remaining categories with your College of Science advisor or myPurduePlan.

university_core_engineering.name: University Core Curriculum & College of Engineering Core
university_core_engineering.note: First-year engineering, written/oral communication, general education, and free electives. Verify remaining categories with your College of Engineering advisor or myPurduePlan.
